protocol.metric_definition: Per-class intersection over union, macro-averaged over occupied semantic classes 0-16; free class 17 excluded; GT 255 ignored; classes with zero union omitted; zero-IoU classes with nonzero union retained
protocol.future_mean_definition: Arithmetic mean of the 12 future-frame mIoUs, excluding the current reconstruction
protocol.target: Occ3D-nuScenes semantic occupancy; no camera or LiDAR visibility mask
protocol.loworld_history: Current joint occupancy/LiDAR latent and four memory frames
protocol.i2world_history: Occupancy history through the original four-frame intra/inter tokenizer and five-frame world-model memory
protocol.conditions: Future ego motion; LO-World additionally receives future BEV layout only in the layout variant
protocol.i2world_horizon_note: Original three-second checkpoint rolled out autoregressively to six seconds
protocol.note: Five examples selected for the largest future-mean semantic mIoU gaps; not a validation-set benchmark

selection.criterion: Largest LO-World minus I²-World future-mean semantic mIoU
